hostContracts.scope: Complete owner shell only in complete main-page assets; this child uses actual parent metadata and a neutral local crop.

compositionRules.hostRendering: Complete authoritative owner/standalone host for full pages. Other surfaces use actual local component on a neutral background or only a small truthful parent cue; do not repeat full rail/sidebar/header. Large windows retain real title/close/body scrolling/footer.
